paper_title: CodeRAG-Bench Can Retrieval Augment Code Generation
caption: Performance with different chunking sizes.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the performance of four different information sources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and GitHub files—across varying chunking sizes, measured in the number of tokens. The x-axis represents the "Number of Tokens" on a linear scale, ranging from 200 to 800, with tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis represents performance, scaled linearly from 10 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The blue line, representing Tutorials, starts at approximately 23 and rises to about 29. The red line, representing Library Documentation, begins at around 27, increases to a peak of 31 near 500 tokens, then slightly declines to about 28. The green line, representing GitHub files, begins at approximately 28, rises to a peak of 32 near 500 tokens, and then slightly declines to about 30. The yellow line, representing StackOverflow posts, starts at 32, decreases steadily to approximately 12 at 800 tokens.
